REVOKE-FIRST for RA-without-intent appends REV process-death; under section 5.4 a whole-generation REV advances grantGeneration, so a supervisor death with one accepted-but-unbegun request rolls the project's grant generation and later operations re-grant. That is fail-closed and lawful under the existing REV reason vocabulary; state the generation-rollover consequence and its cost explicitly in section 7.5 so the reviewer does not read REV as request-local.
The ROOT.CANONICAL refusal detail embeds the exception class name; harmless, but a fixed reason token (e.g. ROOT.CANONICAL:NON_NFC) keeps refusal vocabularies closed.
